Chapter 962 Chapter 21 Everything Is Ready (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 962  Chapter 21 Everything is Ready (Please Subscribe)

Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, one of the nine major cities, Mingchuan City.

Lin Yuan sits cross-legged in a 'guest house room', which is more aptly described as a world in its own right—vast and endless.

The 'guest house' in the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent signifies safety and non-disturbance.

Therefore, the rent is very high.

Lin Yuan paid a price of ten chaos stones to obtain a ten-year residence right for this 'room'.

Ten years...is extraordinarily brief compared to the Chaos Void.

Many ancient Level Twelve beings could nap far longer than ten years.

But considering the time flow rate of the Chaos Void and the universe, ten years in the Chaos Void equals three thousand years in the universe.

If the leasing period expires smoothly, Lin Yuan estimates he'll have reached Level Twelve by then and will be able to continuously send avatars here.

Whether it's to change guest houses or explore other areas.

It's all up to Lin Yuan to choose.

"Chaos Void..."

Lin Yuan keenly senses the vast and profound Rules of the Dao functioning in the Chaos Void.

Compared to the rules within the universe, the Rules of the Dao in the Chaos Void are even loftier.

The main reason Lin Yuan let this incarnation settle in the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent is to fully understand the operations of the Rules of the Dao in the Chaos Void.

"How marvelous."

Lin Yuan can't help but immerse himself in it.

Even though it's just an avatar, as long as it contains the mind and will of Lin Yuan, it possesses the Against-Heaven's Understanding; lights of insight rapidly collide in his mind as he perceives continuously.

[Your understanding is against heaven, feeling the vast rules, your own rule comprehension increases...]

Lin Yuan's vision elevates continually, faintly reaching another plane where a mighty river flows.

"Is this... the Time River of the Chaos Void?"

Lin Yuan instantly realizes.

There is a Time River in the universe, which is the destination for all beings below Level Twelve; naturally, there is also a Time River in the Chaos Void.

Although there are many Level Twelve beings in the Chaos Void, there are even more beings below Level Twelve.

"It's spectacular."

Lin Yuan can't help but feel emotional; the Time River in the Chaos Void is vastly more immense compared to the one in the universe.

If the Time River of the Chaos Void is seen as the main river, then the Time Rivers of various universes are like tributaries branching from it.

The whole Time River of the Chaos Void resembles the veins of a green leaf.

The main river flows grandly, equivalent to the main veins of the leaf, while countless tiny tributaries that branch off are flowing through different universes.

"Space-time..."

Lin Yuan observes the main vein of the Time River continuously; even a simple wave here contains the essence stamps of countless Level Eleven beings.

"I wonder what it would be like if I were in the main vein of the Time River..."

Lin Yuan lets his thoughts wander; with his current essence of life, the tributaries of the Time River can barely contain him anymore.

Only by curling up as much as possible can he stay hidden above the Time River.

But the main vein of the Time River? It is the source of time in the entire Chaos Void, easily accommodating the spectacle beings vastly beyond Level Eleven Perfection.

The Chaos Void is vast and boundless, and although there still exist no Level Eleven beings who have deduced the Chaos Rules, the limit of Level Eleven here far exceeds that within the universe.

The direct disciple of Chaos Venerable? The direct descendants of the Chaos Great Saint? And those spectacle beings nurtured directly by the Chaos Void, whose levels of life are on par with the universe?

Too many legends and inconceivables exist within the Chaos Void.

...

In the center of the Ancient Ming Continent, a sharp black mountain started to tremble lightly.

This black mountain is actually the horn of a Chaos Dragon Beast, whose combat power is nearly comparable to the Chaos Realm. It had once submitted to Ancient Ming Venerable in its early years and its true body resides in deep slumber within the depths of the Chaos Continent.

"What's going on?"

"Why do I vaguely sense a crisis?"

The Chaos Dragon Beast opens its azure eyes, showing a hint of confusion.

As a being directly nurtured by the Chaos Void, the Chaos Dragon Beast could be considered partly a spectacle being, with a trace of time blood flowing in it.

All Level Twelve beings, whether in the Path Splitting Realm, the Dominant Realm, or the Chaos Realm, aspire to transform into Perfect Time Beings as their ultimate goal.

Of course, Perfect Time Beings are too unreachable; for those top peak-perfect Chaos Great Saints, the first transformation needed is into Time Beings, that is, stepping into Level Thirteen.

Level Thirteen Time Beings, although they cannot control the past, present, and future or easily comprehend and jump out of many timelines like Perfect Time Beings can,

they still possess some attributes of Perfect Time Beings, being able to use themselves as anchor points to observe the future.

The future is uncertain, with countless timelines, and Level Thirteen Time Beings have the capability to observe certain timelines in advance, seeing many futures related to themselves.

...

The Chaos Dragon Beast is only nearly on par with the Chaos Realm in terms of combat power, while its actual realm remains the peak of the Dominant Realm.

However, the trace of time blood within it grants it a 'prescient' ability.

This 'prescient' ability is far from observing timelines related to itself like Level Thirteen Time Beings can.

It can merely sense crises, but as for what kind of crisis, when it will occur, and where it comes from,

it cannot know.

Even so,

this ability is extraordinarily monstrous.

It has helped Ancient Ming Venerable avoid many troubles.

"No good, I must quickly inform Ancient Ming." The Chaos Dragon Beast pondered for a moment, its body immediately began to shrink, transforming into a size of ten meters.
